description: Defines JSON response utility functions within the JsonResponses namespace, including error responses and timestamp handling, for use in a larger C++ project.

methods.name: malFormedRequest
methods.description: Creates a JSON object indicating a malformed request, with overloads for different parameter sets.

methods.name: pathNotFound
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a requested path was not found.

methods.name: noAccess
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating access is denied.

methods.name: valueOutOfBounds
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a value is out of bounds.

methods.name: notSetResponse
methods.description: Sets a 'not set' response in a provided JSON object.

methods.name: getTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp as a string.

methods.name: addTimeStampToJSON
methods.description: Adds a timestamp to a JSON object with an optional suffix.

methods.name: convertJSONTimeStampToISO8601
methods.description: Converts timestamps in a JSON object to ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: getTimeStampZero
methods.description: Returns a zero or null timestamp string.
